svg.title: Serenity UAV build guide 11 - TRUNNION + PINION: HANG THE NACELLE
svg.metadata: SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-SA-4.0. Generated by tools/gen_build_guide_cards.py; edit the CARDS table, not this file.
svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
2 x 6704ZZ on the fixed spar, 14T into the 50T ring gear (port pod hidden)
Seat the trunnion with its 6704ZZ pair on the fixed spar at the wing tip.
Run the 4 mm shaft out through its bushings; mesh the 14T pinion with the 50T ring gear.
Fit the AK7455 at the trunnion ring magnet.
Fit the hard stops at -5 and 140 deg.
Command -5 -> 90 -> 135 deg and back; set soft limits to -5 and 135 deg.
Open owner decision: the 6704ZZ pair runs at 89 % of C0 under ultimate load (NACELLE_64MM_VERIFICATION 5b).
SOURCE: REVN_BUILD_GUIDE_24IN.md Phase 3; owner ruling 2026-10-31 (tilt range)
